meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 方法在 NanoClaw 群里建立并维护持久 wiki:把你给的资料分类收纳,整理成可检索的百科条目,并把维护规则写进群说明;多个文件时逐个处理完再处理下一个。
howto.when: 当你说出“add wiki”、“wiki”、“knowledge base”等关键词,或要求给 NanoClaw 群加 wiki 知识库时触发。

say.text: 请给这个群加上 wiki 知识库
say.note: Claude 会先问选哪个群,再和你一起设计知识库。

say.text: 请把这份资料收进知识库
请每周做一次 wiki 健康检查
say.note: Claude 会安排周期性的 lint 检查。

howto.what_en: Claude sets up a persistent wiki in a NanoClaw group per Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern: material is stored in organized folders, turned into searchable wiki pages, and maintenance rules are written into the group CLAUDE.md. Multiple files are processed one by one.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", etc., or ask to add a wiki knowledge base to a group.

say_en.text: Please add a wiki knowledge base to this group.
say_en.note: Claude will ask which group and design the wiki with you.

say_en.text: Please add this material to the knowledge base.
say_en.note: Claude reads it, discusses takeaways, and updates wiki pages.

say_en.text: Please run a weekly wiki health check.
say_en.note: Claude schedules a periodic lint task.
